sara: Planning a staggered rack rotation + node reboots in us-central on Sun 2026-04-05 01:30-03:00 UTC. Goal: apply NIC microcode and reboot without impacting hosted model SLOs. Using conservative interleave and preheat. Thread for coordination. cc @micah-oncall @rana

ops-bot: maintenance-scheduler created event maint-179100 for 2026-04-05 01:30-03:00 UTC. Owners notified.

liam: which rack is our canary? what's expected capacity drain per pool?

sara: Canary is rack-23. We'll cap drain to <=12% per hosted pool. Plan: stagger nodes so no more than 1 node/rack drains concurrently, with 7m spacing between reboots across racks. High-level timeline:

```
01:30-01:45 UTC 1rack-23 canary: drain node-23a, verify, reboot, post-check (10m)
01:45-02:45 UTC 1interleaved reboots across racks [rack-23,rack-07,rack-31,rack-12]
02:45-02:55 UTC 1kv-cache warmseed for embeddings/chat hot-prefixes + smoke
02:55-03:00 UTC 1rollback windows closed, revert routing weights
```

rana: we'll need to pre-seed both embedding caches and autoreg/kvcache for chat models. I recommend warm_top_prefixes.sh --top 50 and embeddings prefetch for top-50 customers. Liam, can you own the seed job?

liam: 👍 will run: `tools/kvseed/warm_top_prefixes.sh --top 50 --parallel 6` and `tools/emb-prefetch/prefetch.py --customers 50` starting 01:10 UTC so seeds finish before canary completes.

sara: Ops note on routing: we'll shift 10% egress weight to us-east as safety during each per-rack drain. Traffic-policy change will be automated via infra-routing with a ttl of 5m; rollback if p50 token latency increases >20ms or error rate +2% absolute.

micah-oncall: I'll be oncall for the window. Ping me 20m before start and at canary completion. If p99 token latency spikes >200ms or error rate breaches SLO for >2 minutes, trigger rollback playbook.

dana: cost reminder: if we backfill with spot instances, short-term cost dips but higher preemption risk which increases error tail. Dedicated short-burst is safer for SLAs but ~3x $/hr. Recommend using spot backfill for non-critical pools and dedicated burst for priority pools. We need decision by Fri EOD.

liam: adding telemetry checks to the runbook: token p50/p95/p99, request error rate, model availability per shard, and kv-cache hit-rate. I'll publish thresholds in the runbook.

sara: Quick runbook snippet for the ops team:

```
# drain
kubectl drain $NODE --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --timeout=400s
# enable temporary routing shift
infra-routing shift --from us-central --to us-east --percent 10 --ttl 300
# healthcheck
scripts/node-smoke.sh $NODE || scripts/rollback-node.sh $NODE
```

rana: I'll draft tenant comms: short notice to support channels + status page update. Message: "Maintenance in US-Central for NIC microcode and minor reboots. Some requests may be routed to fallback region briefly. No persistent interruptions expected."

micah-oncall: noted. I'll be ready to execute rollback. Also recommend we run a preflight loadtest on the canary rack traffic mirror at 00:50 UTC to validate no cold-start latency cliffs.

liam: scheduled preflight mirror at 00:50, small synthetic load. If p95 latency >15% baseline, abort.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled 12h reminder sent for maint-179100 to owners.

sara: Thanks team. I'll post the final runbook link here tomorrow and attach the rollback playbook.
